summary.text: Dave Maxey is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 83 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election (Ballotpedia lists no other candidate in the general election).
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in sales.

paragraphs.text: Dave Maxey was born in Oconomowoc, Wisconsin, and graduated from Brookfield East High School in 1991.

He served in the U.S. Navy from 1991 to 1994, then earned an associate degree in marketing from Waukesha County Technical College in 2002 and a certificate in social media marketing from the same college in 2017.
His career experience includes working in sales.
Maxey served on the New Berlin School Board from 2008 to 2017 and was elected to the New Berlin City Council in 2019.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Campaigns and Elections (chair), Corrections, Local Government, Public Benefit Reform (vice-chair), Transportation, and Veterans and Military Affairs.
